methods.declaration: public static bool EqualsWildcard(this string text, string wildcardString)
methods.summary:
Compares a string to a wildcard pattern.
'?' matches any single character.
'*' matches any sequence of zero or more characters.
This implementation is case-sensitive.

parameters.name: wildcardString
parameters.description: The wildcard pattern to match against.

methods.returns: bool: True if the string matches the pattern, otherwise false.
